name: myfaker
description: Test people for filling in forms: names, addresses, phone numbers and documents the way each country writes them, with check digits that pass validation

scripts.check:syntax: for f in public/app.js public/i18n.js server/*.js server/countries/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:i18n && npm run test:unit && npm run smoke
